scope: Quality reference on unchanged saved public ASR text, not product selection or an end-to-end endpoint test

inputs.selection: All original 20 IDs and both saved ASR variants, original order and labels; no transcript corrections, suffix rules or extra prompts

method: Official fast tokenizer JSON with special tokens, single text, no padding; reject capacity overflow rather than truncate; ONNX CPU single thread, original two-class argmax (0=unfinished,1=finished), no threshold tuning
repeatability: Three consecutive fixed-order runs; report all results, changes and warm wall-time percentiles, separate first and model-load times
qualification: Report original failure, all new premature completions and complete-utterance misses against the original labels. Any failure stops product selection; do not sweep thresholds or hide failures with averages
boundaries: Saved ASR text is not ground truth. No new ASR calls or future transcript prefixes.
Classifier-only timing is not endpoint latency; no replay of natural pauses is claimed.
A passing reference would still require approval before replacing the confirmed device-side audio-only design.
No deployment, ADB, real recording, paid API, prompt or permission changes.
